title: Markerless pose to gait: OpenPose -> poseFix -> analysis
text: Markerless pose estimators (OpenPose, MediaPipe, DeepLabCut) turn ordinary video 2D keypoint trajectories, trajectories noisy: keypoints drop , jump, – legs cross gait – get left/right labels swapped. vignette runs full chain: PhysioMoCap already ingests pose data (readOpenPose(), readMediaPipe(), readDeepLabCut(), readOpenCap()) PhysioExperiment, provides downstream biomechanics. poseFix() cleaning step (generalised implementation method Sugiyama, Uno & Matsui 2023, PLOS Comput Biol 19:e1009989).
code: readOpenPose()  ->  poseFix()  ->  joint angles / gait metrics  ->  downstream    (ingest)        (clean)          (analyse)

title: Markerless pose to gait: OpenPose -> poseFix -> analysis
text: keep vignette self-contained simulate short walking recording structure readOpenPose() returns – assays keypoint_x, keypoint_y, confidence, named keypoints – inject three characteristic errors.
code: labels <- c("Neck", "RShoulder", "LShoulder", "MidHip",             "RHip", "RKnee", "RAnkle", "LHip", "LKnee", "LAnkle") base_x <- c(0, -18, 18, 0, -10, -10, -10, 10, 10, 10) base_y <- c(0, 15, 15, 60, 60, 105, 150, 60, 105, 150) n <- 240; t <- seq_len(n) sway <- 8 * sin(2 * pi * t / 48)               # gait sway flex <- 6 * (1 - cos(2 * pi * t / 48))         # knee flexion over the cycle  X <- outer(rep(1, n), base_x); Y <- outer(rep(1, n), base_y) colnames(X) <- colnames(Y) <- labels for (kp in c("RKnee", "RAnkle")) X[, kp] <- X[, kp] + sway for (kp in c("LKnee", "LAnkle")) X[, kp] <- X[, kp] - sway X[, "RKnee"] <- X[, "RKnee"] + flex; X[, "LKnee"] <- X[, "LKnee"] - flex X <- X + matrix(rnorm(n * ncol(X), 0, 0.6), n) Y <- Y + matrix(rnorm(n * ncol(Y), 0, 0.6), n) conf <- matrix(0.9, n, ncol(X), dimnames = list(NULL, labels))  # inject errors: a confidence dropout, a jump, and a left/right leg swap conf[60, "RKnee"] <- 0.02                                        # dropout X[110, "RAnkle"] <- X[110, "RAnkle"] + 90                        # jump swap <- 150:n                                                    # leg-label swap for (pr in list(c("RHip","LHip"), c("RKnee","LKnee"), c("RAnkle","LAnkle"))) {   tx <- X[swap, pr[1]]; X[swap, pr[1]] <- X[swap, pr[2]]; X[swap, pr[2]] <- tx   ty <- Y[swap, pr[1]]; Y[swap, pr[1]] <- Y[swap, pr[2]]; Y[swap, pr[2]] <- ty }  pose <- PhysioCore::PhysioExperiment(   assays = S4Vectors::SimpleList(keypoint_x = X, keypoint_y = Y, confidence = conf),   colData = S4Vectors::DataFrame(label = labels, type = "keypoint",                                  model = "BODY_25"),   samplingRate = 30) pose #> class: PhysioExperiment #> dim: 240 x 10  #> assays(3): keypoint_x, keypoint_y, confidence #> samplingRate: 30 Hz #> channels(10): Neck, RShoulder, LShoulder, MidHip, RHip ... #> colData names(3): label, type, model

title: Markerless pose to gait: OpenPose -> poseFix -> analysis
text: poseFix() first restores left/right leg continuity, flags keypoints four criteria (low confidence, implausible segment length, frame--frame jump, --range joint angle), sets NA, interpolates smooths.
code: fixed <- poseFix(pose) report <- S4Vectors::metadata(fixed)$poseFix report$counts          # anomalies flagged, by criterion #> low_confidence segment_length  temporal_jump    joint_angle  #>              1              1              2             24 report$leg_swaps       # frames whose left/right legs were un-swapped #> [1] 91

title: Markerless pose to gait: OpenPose -> poseFix -> analysis
text: jump frame 110 left/right swap frame 150 gone; cleaned trajectory (red) continuous.
code: rx  <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(pose,  "keypoint_x")[, "RAnkle"] rxc <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(fixed, "keypoint_x")[, "RAnkle"] plot(rx, type = "l", col = "grey70", xlab = "frame",      ylab = "right-ankle x", main = "Right-ankle trajectory") lines(rxc, col = "firebrick", lwd = 2) legend("topleft", c("raw", "poseFix"), col = c("grey70", "firebrick"),        lwd = c(1, 2), bty = "n")

title: Markerless pose to gait: OpenPose -> poseFix -> analysis
text: cleaned keypoints flow straight analysis. right-knee angle (hip-knee-ankle) computed raw vs cleaned keypoints:  raw angle corrupted errors; poseFix() clean, cyclic gait signal ready step segmentation, range--motion, muscle-synergy network analyses elsewhere ecosystem.
code: knee_angle <- function(pe, hip, knee, ankle) {   X <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(pe, "keypoint_x")   Y <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(pe, "keypoint_y")   v1x <- X[, hip] - X[, knee]; v1y <- Y[, hip] - Y[, knee]   v2x <- X[, ankle] - X[, knee]; v2y <- Y[, ankle] - Y[, knee]   acos(pmin(pmax((v1x * v2x + v1y * v2y) /     (sqrt(v1x^2 + v1y^2) * sqrt(v2x^2 + v2y^2)), -1), 1)) * 180 / pi } a_raw   <- knee_angle(pose,  "RHip", "RKnee", "RAnkle") a_fixed <- knee_angle(fixed, "RHip", "RKnee", "RAnkle") plot(a_raw, type = "l", col = "grey70", xlab = "frame",      ylab = "right-knee angle (deg)", main = "Knee flexion") lines(a_fixed, col = "steelblue", lwd = 2) legend("topright", c("raw", "poseFix"), col = c("grey70", "steelblue"),        lwd = c(1, 2), bty = "n")

title: PhysioMoCap: Motion Capture and Biomechanics Analysis for PhysioExperiment Objects — PhysioMoCap-package
text: Provides motion capture, pose estimation, biomechanical simulation analysis PhysioExperiment objects. Includes /O C3D, Venus3D, GaitRec, OpenPose, DeepLabCut, MediaPipe, BVH, ASF/AMC, OpenSim, generic CSV formats. Provides marker tracking (Hungarian algorithm), signal filtering, numerical differentiation, resampling, center mass calculation, gait parameters, clinical statistics (ICC, SEM, MDC, Bland-Altman), movement phase segmentation, dynamic time warping, movement normalization, functional PCA, force-plate kinetics (GRF filtering, COP, loading rate, impulse), planar inverse dynamics (joint moments/power), EMG integration (rectification, RMS envelope, MVC normalization), gait/running/jump task schemas, OpenSim workflow integration, biomechanics-specific visualization.

title: Calculate whole-body center of mass from marker positions — calculateCOM
text: algorithm proceeds follows: body segment, compute segment COM position : $$COM_{seg} = P_{prox} + f \times (P_{dist} - P_{prox})$$ \(f\) COM proximal fraction BSIP table. Compute whole-body COM mass-weighted average segment COMs: $$COM_{body} = \frac{\sum_i m_i \times COM_i}{M}$$ \(m_i = M \times f_i\) segment mass \(M\) total body mass.

text: "3point" convention, angle computed vertex (joint point) proximal--joint distal--joint direction vectors: $$\theta = \arccos\left(\frac{v_1 \cdot v_2}{|v_1| |v_2|}\right)$$ \(v_1 = \text{proximal} - \text{joint}\) \(v_2 = \text{distal} - \text{joint}\). result clamped \([0, \pi]\) (\([0, 180]\) degrees). three points contain NA given frame, angle frame NA.

text: unsigned vertex angle tell flexion hyperextension: knee flexed 10 degrees knee hyperextended 10 degrees give included angle 170 degrees, \(\arccos\) discards side proximal segment distal segment lies . signed = TRUE angle instead $$\theta = \mathrm{atan2}\left((v_1' \times v_2') \cdot \hat{n},\;   v_1' \cdot v_2'\right)$$ \(\hat{n}\) unit plane_normal \(v_i'\) \(v_i\) \(\hat{n}\) component removed. magnitude included angle whenever three points lie plane; sign positive rotation \(v_1\) \(v_2\) follows right-hand rule \(\hat{n}\), flips distal segment crosses side proximal segment. Choose (negate) plane_normal direction flexion, giving clinical flexion(+) / extension(-) convention; corresponding deviation straight (anatomically neutral) position 180 - abs(theta). range \((-180, 180]\), signed angle wraps exactly straight configuration - pose whose two sides sign tell apart. joint moves full extension therefore steps +180 -180, differentiating series directly gives spurious spike. Work 180 - abs(theta) (continuous neutral pose) unwrap series differentiating. 2D data (position_z assay) default normal global z axis, positive angle means distal vector counter-clockwise proximal vector x-y plane. 3D data plane_normal = NULL normal least-variance direction two joint vectors frames (best-fit plane), defined global flip; function warns case flexion(+) direction property data rather clinical convention. \(v_i\) projected onto plane, --plane motion makes signed magnitude smaller unsigned 3D angle; two agree exactly planar motion. "groodsuntay" / "ISB", proximal distal anatomical frame built joint (via jointCoordinateSystem()) three signed angles extracted groodSuntayAngles(). sequence- dependent Grood-Suntay floating-axis (Z-X-Y Cardan) decomposition: flexion (proximal medio-lateral axis) extracted first internal/ external rotation (distal long axis) last.

title: Floquet multipliers (orbital stability of a cyclic movement) — floquetMultipliers
code: set.seed(1) A <- matrix(c(0.5, 0.1, 0, 0.3), 2, 2)             # stride-to-stride return map P <- 4; nS <- 80; strides <- array(0, c(nS, P, 2)); d <- rnorm(2) cyc <- cbind(sin(1:P), cos(1:P)) for (n in 1:nS) { for (k in 1:P) strides[n, k, ] <- cyc[k, ] + d   d <- as.numeric(A %*% d) + rnorm(2, 0, 0.01) } floquetMultipliers(strides)$max_multiplier          # ~ 0.5 (< 1, stable) #> [1] 0.4317407

Segment centres mass come anthropometric ratios inertial, linear angular accelerations numerical differentiation marker trajectories, segment mass source (inertial body_mass) foot distal end (toe_x, toe_y) required. recursion differentiates marker trajectories twice, amplifies marker noise: joint moments good smoothing applied beforehand. static limb sampled 200 Hz, 1 mm white marker noise produces spurious moment 24 times true value; 6 Hz zero-lag low-pass (butterworthFilter(), filterSignals() positions) reduces order magnitude. "quasi_static" reproduces pre-1.0 behaviour: joint moment moment ground reaction force alone joint centre, plus optional \(\alpha\) term. omits segment weight linear inertia entirely, returns identically zero whenever limb ground (whole swing phase) underestimates stance moments - hip roughly 8% quiet standing. kept analyses published old implementation can reproduced, emits message selected.

what: Detect and correct pose-estimation anomalies — poseFix
title: Detect and correct pose-estimation anomalies — poseFix
text: Cleans markerless-pose recording (e.g. readOpenPose()) detecting biomechanically implausible keypoints correcting , connecting pose estimation downstream joint-angle / gait / kinematics analysis. Anomalies flagged four criteria (Sugiyama, Uno & Matsui 2023): low detector confidence; segment (bone) lengths deviate subject's median; frame--frame jumps larger fraction body scale; joint angles outside empirical range. Flagged coordinates set NA, linearly interpolated, optionally smoothed. References derived recording , method model-agnostic.

code: fs <- 200 mk <- function(catch, rise, total = 0.8) {   t <- seq(0, total, by = 1 / fs)   ifelse(t <= rise, catch * t / rise, catch + 8 * (t - rise) / (total - rise)) } st <- lapply(list(c(30, .5), c(20, .25), c(15, .13)),              function(p) tardieuStretch(mk(p[1], p[2]), sampling_rate = fs,                                         onset = "velocity")) reflexThreshold(st)$slope #> [1] -0.2571113

title: Savitzky-Golay filter for smoothing and differentiation — savgolFilter

what: Pure-R static optimization of muscle activations — staticOptimizationR
title: Pure-R static optimization of muscle activations — staticOptimizationR
text: Distributes net joint moment time frame across muscles minimising sum squared activations (quadratic muscle-effort criterion), subject moments reproduced exactly activation staying within bounds: $$\min_a \sum_i w_i a_i^2 \quad \text{s.t.} \quad       \tau_j = \sum_i a_i F^{max}_i r_{ji}, \; 0 \le a_i \le 1.$$ frame independent convex quadratic program (solved quadprog), giving unique minimum-effort activations. mirrors OpenSim Static Optimization tool (Anderson & Pandy 2001) used runStaticOptimization() OpenSim unavailable.

text: measures defined relative mean CoP. \(RD_n\) resultant distance sample \(n\) mean CoP \(T\) trial duration: Path length (total excursion, TOTEX): summed point--point distance; mean velocity TOTEX / T. RMS distance (RDIST) mean distance (MDIST), resultant per-axis. 95% confidence circle area (AREA-CC) \(= \pi (MDIST + z\, s_{RD})^2\) \(z = 1.645\). 95% confidence ellipse area (AREA-CE) \(= 2\pi F_{0.05[2,n-2]} \sqrt{s_{AP}^2 s_{ML}^2 - s_{AP,ML}^2}\). Sway area (AREA-SW), area swept per unit time. Mean frequency (MFREQ), equivalent rotational frequency \(MVELO / (2\pi\, MDIST)\). Fractal dimension (FD-CC) frequency-domain measures (total power, 50%/95% power frequency, centroidal frequency, frequency dispersion). Non-linear sample entropy DFA-\(\alpha\) per axis, optional time--boundary base support supplied.

Tremor: tremorSpectrum() (dependency-free Welch periodogram → dominant frequency, -band power, half-power bandwidth, harmonic ratio 3-12 Hz band), tremorAmplitude() (band-limited RMS) tremorMetrics() (combined, tagged rest/postural/kinetic). Instrumented spasticity (Tardieu): tardieuStretch() locates catch (EMG reflex onset /velocity arrest) → R1; tardieuScore() derives R2 dynamic component R2-R1; reflexThreshold() regresses catch angle stretch velocity. Reuses EMG↔︎MoCap alignment, envelope angular-velocity primitives already package.

title: PhysioMoCap 0.6.2

Previously NULL time_range left tool templates’ <time_range>0 1</time_range> place, silently truncating every trial first second. tools now defaults "ik" (matching documentation); previous c("ik","id","") default made bare call error ground-reaction requirement. Inverse kinematics run ID/setups written, motion input real rather empty placeholder; failed IK now reported instead crashing MOT reader 0-byte file, reused-workdir stale outputs longer attributed run. runOpenSimFromOpenCap() resolves OpenCap session (model markers come trial, duplicate requests), validates session_id supplied external_loads_file downloading, records resolved trial id. .opencap_model_url handling tolerates empty/NA/non-scalar session metadata; partial templates override keeps bundled defaults tools.

ID/require external_loads_file (markerless OpenCap ground reactions); dry_run = TRUE writes setups without backend. runOpenSimFromOpenCap() runs chain directly OpenCap session, downloadOpenCapModel() fetches session’s scaled .osim model (input local OpenSim toolchain needs, since OpenCap scaling). Also available poseFix(..., length_correct = TRUE). Generalised form length correction PoseFixeR (Sugiyama, Uno & Matsui 2023).

title: PhysioMoCap 0.3.1
text: poseFix() gains left/right leg-swap correction (deswap = TRUE): leg-label swaps pose estimators make legs cross gait corrected restoring trajectory continuity, anomaly steps. number corrections reported metadata()$poseFix$leg_swaps.

title: PhysioMoCap 0.3.0
text: poseFix() — pose-estimation anomaly detection correction, connecting markerless pose input (readOpenPose() / readMediaPipe() / readDeepLabCut()) downstream joint-angle / gait / kinematics analysis. Flags keypoints four criteria (low detector confidence, implausible segment lengths, frame--frame jumps, --range joint angles), interpolates smooths . Generalised, name-based, self-referential reimplementation method PoseFixeR (Sugiyama, Uno & Matsui 2023, PLOS Comput Biol 19:e1009989).

title: PhysioMoCap 0.2.2
text: Made OpenSim MOT/TRC read/write round-trip tests portable macOS: now assert numerical equality (expect_equal) recovered data rather bit-identity (expect_identical). Writing numeric data decimal ASCII file (17 significant digits) recovers values exactly correctly- rounded libc (glibc) ~1 ULP macOS’s printf/strtod, bit- identical round-trip portable guarantee; data still preserved full double precision. writer/reader behaviour changed.

title: PhysioMoCap 0.2.1
text: Bundled independent OpenSim inverse-dynamics reference (inst/extdata/gait2392_id_reference.rds) inverseDynamicsRNE() cross-tool test now runs instead skipping. fixture derived OpenSim gait2392 subject01_walk1 trial (opensim-models, Apache-2.0) OpenSim 4.6’s InverseDynamicsTool; recursive Newton-Euler solver reproduces OpenSim hip/knee/ankle moments r > 0.99 < 8% peak error. Generation documented data-raw/gait2392_id_reference*.

title: PhysioMoCap 0.2.0
text: Added Venus3D CSV reader (readVenus3D()) OptiTrack -> Motive -> Venus3D pipeline exports automatic header metadata parsing. trackMarkers() — Hungarian algorithm (via clue) greedy assignment establishing consistent marker identities across frames. detectSwaps() — velocity-spike-based swap detection cross-validation. correctSwaps() — automatic swap repair based detection results. readMoCapAuto() now auto-detects Venus3D CSV files (#Venus3D header). Added clue Suggests optimal assignment marker tracking.
